desc.en: When Flaming Will is triggered, Verna: Summer Dive!'s ATK increases by 5% and her Crit Rate increases by 10%. (Max Stacks: 2, Duration: 15s, new stacks reset the duration) / The Fire DMG Boost of Ember changes to 4%.

Upon switching to another teammate during combat, Verna's Support DMG increases by 10% for 15s, and the duration she remains on the field for increases by 4s. / Also, she uses her Special Skill once upon switching to another teammate. This Special Skill is used regardless of cooldown and does not trigger its cooldown after use.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Basic Attack DMG by 6%.

The Total DMG of Verna: Summer Dive!'s Special Skill increases by 20%. Upon landing a Basic Fire Attack, her Special Skill's cooldown decreases by 0.2s. (Cooldown: 0.1s) / Upon switching to another teammate during combat, the duration she remains on the field for additionally increases by 4s.

name.en: Let's Make This Party Even Hotter!

desc.en: The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Special Skill DMG by 6%.

In the effect description of Ember, the condition "when Verna: Summer Dive! is not being controlled" is removed, and the effect value of Ember is always multiplied by 2. / Also, upon landing a Fire attack while controlling Verna: Summer Dive!, Crit Rate increases by 3% and Crit DMG increases by 5% for 1.5s. (Max Stacks: 10, new stacks reset the duration) When this effect is at max stacks, ATK increases by an additional 30% and Pierce Rate increases by 15%.
Verna deals Physical DMG to enemies by consecutively striking them with her sword. / When Flaming Will is active, all attacks except for her 1st Hit are enhanced, and a 5th Hit can be triggered.

Verna: Summer Dive! appears near the enemy and generates a powerful blade of fire beneath them, striking upward to deal Fire DMG. / Using her Switch Skill while Flaming Will is active triggers an enhanced skill, dealing powerful Fire DMG. / If the Special Skill button is pressed at the right time during her Enhanced Switch Skill, a photo of Verna: Summer Dive! is taken. Then, it ends the Switch Skill sooner and activates her Special Skill. This Special Skill activates regardless of its cooldown. Attack Speed Boost and Reduction effects do not apply while photos are being taken.

label.en: Enhanced DMG When Flaming Will Is Active

desc.en: Verna releases fire energy around herself, dealing Fire DMG. / Using her Special Skill while Flaming Will is active triggers an enhanced skill, dealing powerful Fire DMG and refreshing the duration of Flaming Will.

label.en: Enhanced DMG When Flaming Will Is Active

desc.en: Verna gathers a large amount of fire energy and unleashes a powerful thrust forward, inflicting Fire Affliction. / If she uses her Ultimate Skill while Flaming Will is active, a blade of fire is generated, dealing bonus Fire DMG and refreshing the duration of Flaming Will.

label.en: Bonus DMG When Flaming Will Is Active

desc.en: Using any of Verna: Summer Dive!'s skills except her Basic Attack, including Evasion Counter and Air Counter, converts the element of all her attacks to Fire and decreases DMG Taken for a set duration. The duration does not decrease while Verna: Summer Dive! is not being actively controlled in combat. / Landing a Fire attack during this duration grants Ember.
Hitting an enemy with a Fire attack decreases the target's DEF by 15.5% for 4s.
Afflicted targets take Fire DMG over time, and Fire RES decreases by 15%.

Converts the element of all attacks to Fire, and decreases DMG Taken by 35%. The duration does not decrease while Verna: Summer Dive! is not being actively controlled in combat. / Landing a Fire attack during this duration grants Ember.
Fire DMG increases by 2%. (Max Stacks: 5, new stacks reset the duration) / When Verna: Summer Dive! is not being controlled, the effect value of Ember is doubled.
